name: The Wrath of Khan — chapter I takes its target and gives it haste once the next combat has begun
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. Chapter I's 'It gains haste until end of turn' gave the Saga itself haste, the chapter had no target picker, and 'gain control of that creature' was never read. A Saga chapter's 'it' / 'that creature' is now the target its line names, as a spell's is, and the delayed 'At the beginning of the next combat this turn, gain control …' (with the untap and haste after it) waits for a toggle, 'The next combat has begun', No to begin. With it set to Yes the opponent's Bears are yours and have haste; the Hill Giant and the Saga are untouched. The picker still lists the Bears once they are yours (the controller rule keeps the current target).
